Plugin/entity annotations -> PHP 8 attributes (@ContentEntityType, @Block, @Condition, @Filter, @QueueWorker; deprecated at discovery in 11.4, removed in 13.0)
LegacyWidget::getOriginalWidget() reads ->original (silenced deprecation from 11.2, removed in 12.0): use core getOriginal() once the floor is ^11.2

new static() x7 (PHPStan unsafe usage), \Drupal::entityTypeManager() in WidgetReindexWorker::processItem() -> injected service, @var hints for EntityInterface inference (WidgetReindexWorker:68-69, LegacyWidgetsKernelTest:45-46)
Optional hook_entity_operation() $cacheability parameter (must stay optional while the floor is below 11.3)
Test metadata: PHPUnit attributes (#[Group], #[CoversClass], #[DataProvider]) and #[RunTestsInSeparateProcesses] on the Kernel test (exception in Drupal 12)

Pre-existing hygiene: orphan service legacy_widgets.legacy_exporter, extra @logger.factory argument on legacy_widgets.counter, configure: route name, config/plugin schemas, undeclared legacy_widgets/node dependencies of legacy_widgets_extra

manual_edits.why: Neither info.yml admitted Drupal 11; keep-d10 strategy (no BC break, minor bump). composer.json already declares require.php >=8.1 (the helper value), left as is.

manual_edits.edit: src/Entity/LegacyWidget.php: getOriginal() renamed to getOriginalWidget(); caller in modules/legacy_widgets_extra/legacy_widgets_extra.module updated
manual_edits.why: Drupal 11.2+ EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static makes the untyped local method a class-declaration fatal at entity-type discovery (all 5 Kernel tests fataled in the baseline). A typed override would recurse through core __get(original); parent::getOriginal() does not exist on Drupal 10.

manual_edits.edit: src/Form/SettingsForm.php: inject TypedConfigManagerInterface (config.typed) and forward it to ConfigFormBase::__construct()
manual_edits.why: ConfigFormBase::__construct() requires the typed config manager from Drupal 11.0 (ArgumentCountError otherwise); the extra argument is ignored by 10.0/10.1 (core matrix: runtime-tolerated).

manual_edits.edit: src/Form/WidgetImportForm.php: stop redeclaring FormBase::$loggerFactory (setLoggerFactory() in the constructor); $entityTypeManager promoted as protected, non-readonly
manual_edits.why: private readonly redeclaration of LoggerChannelTrait property is a class-load fatal on PHP 8.1+ and breaks DependencySerializationTrait (pre-existing on Drupal 10, same fatal on 11).

manual_edits.edit: src/LegacyWidgetStorage.php: unused helper buildRevisionCacheId() renamed to buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()
manual_edits.why: Drupal 11.3+ core declares and uses ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId(): the helper would silently override core revision cache ids (scan-signature-changes warn).
check-port-safety.sh class-case error (pre-existing): fatal on case-sensitive filesystems; the gate must exit 0.

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.legacy_exporter' points at class Drupal\legacy_widgets\Export\LegacyExporter, but src/Export/LegacyExporter.php does not exist (orphan service): fetching it is a fatal error.
findings.suggestion: Remove the service definition, or restore/rename the class.

findings.message: Config 'legacy_widgets.settings' has no schema in config/schema/*.schema.yml: strict config schema checks (Kernel/Functional tests, config inspector) fail on it and its values are not typed or translatable.
findings.suggestion: Add a 'legacy_widgets.settings:' entry (type: config_object for simple config) to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml.

findings.message: configure: 'legacy_widgets.settings' names a route that no *.routing.yml of the extension defines: core drops the Configure link from /admin/modules silently (unless a route subscriber or another module provides it).
findings.suggestion: Point it at the real route ('legacy_widgets.settings_form'?).

findings.message: Service 'legacy_widgets.counter' passes 3 argument(s) but Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetCounter::__construct() takes 2: PHP silently ignores the extra one(s) (a stale argument, or a constructor that lost a parameter).
findings.suggestion: Drop the extra argument(s), or restore the constructor parameter they were meant for.

findings.message: Condition plugin 'legacy_widgets_enabled' has its own settings but no 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled' schema: only core's generic 'condition.plugin.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'condition.plugin.legacy_widgets_enabled:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: Filter plugin 'legacy_widgets_summary' has its own settings but no 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary' schema: only core's generic 'filter_settings.*' covers it, so its extra settings fail strict config schema checks.
findings.suggestion: Add 'filter_settings.legacy_widgets_summary:' to config/schema/legacy_widgets.schema.yml describing the plugin's settings.

findings.message: 'legacy_widgets_extra' uses project module 'legacy_widgets' (class,service) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.
'legacy_widgets_extra' uses core module 'node' (class) without declaring it in legacy_widgets_extra.info.yml dependencies: installing 'legacy_widgets_extra' alone fails or breaks at runtime.

findings.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.
findings.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
findings.message: legacy_widgets_entity_operation() implements hook_entity_operation(), which core invokes with 2 argument(s) from Drupal 11.3; the current 1-parameter form works on every core. If you accept the new parameter, keep it optional while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.
